draft.shortGloss: grandfather; polite pronoun for an older man

notes: Ông is used both as a noun meaning grandfather and as a polite second- or third-person pronoun for an older man.
Do not confuse with bà (grandmother) or anh (older brother).

senses.definition: The father of your father or mother.

examples.translation: My grandfather likes to drink tea in the morning.
examples.emotion: fond and respectful, remembering an elder

senses.definition: A polite pronoun used to address or refer to an older man.
